title: Global mapping-complex comparison for the prescribed limit
statement:
For the same normalized DVR tower, coherent finite identifications, and integral limit presentation as lem-coef-integral-dualizing-mapping-limit, there is a natural isomorphism of functors
`integralDualizingGlobalHom l E X M.obj` and
`(integralDualizingCompactSections l E D hl X).op ⋙ coefficientDerivedDual (integralDualizingCoefficients l E)`.

source.place: Second proof paragraph; strict conjunct of the mapping-limit conclusion.

proof.text: Carry out the displayed mapping-tower comparison: apply the finite mapping adjunctions levelwise, use the coherent counit transitions, identify the Roos limit with the coefficient dual tower, and pass to the derived limit. The degree-zero case additionally applies derived global sections and the coefficient-point equivalence.
